📖 How to use

      
  1. Upload the first PDF ("Document A").
  2. Upload the second PDF ("Document B").
  3. Click "Compare" to extract text and build the diff.
  4. Review added/removed line counts and the side-by-side view.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does it compare scanned PDFs?
The tool compares extracted text, not scanned images. PDFs without a text layer (pure scans) will show as empty.
How are long lines handled?
Long lines are truncated for readability; the diff marks whole changed lines so you can spot differences fast.
Are my files uploaded anywhere?
Everything runs locally in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
